name: Increased Maximum HP
effect: Maximum HP raised by 10% / 15%.

name: Increased Maximum FP
effect: Maximum FP raised by 10% / 15%.

name: Reduced FP Consumption
effect: Lowers FP consumption by 10% / 15%.

name: Increased Maximum Stamina
effect: Maximum stamina raised by 10% / 15%.

name: Improved Stamina Recovery
effect: Raises stamina recovery speed by 4 / 6 per second.

name: Improved Physical Attack Power
effect: Raises Physical attack by 6% / 9%.

name: Improved Affinity Attack Power
effect: Raises attacks of magic, fire, lightning, holy affinities by 5% / 8%.

name: Improved Stance-Breaking
effect: Attacks are 10% / 15% more likely to break stance of enemies.

name: Improved Physical Damage Negation
effect: Increases physical damage negation by 12% / 15% / 18%.

name: Improved Affinity Damage Negation
effect: Increases affinity damage negation by 12% / 15% / 18%.

name: All Resistances Up
effect: Raises resistance to all ailments by 57 / 75.

name: Improved Poise
effect: Reduces incoming poise damage by 25% / 38%.

name: Improved Sorceries & Incantations
effect: Raises potency of sorceries and incantations by 7%.

name: Increased Sorcery & Incantation Duration
effect: Extends spell effect duration by 30%.

name: Dragonwound upon Dragon Communion
effect: Dragon Communion incantations add anti-dragon effect to armament.

name: Successful Parries Activate Golden Retaliation
effect: Parry to dispel incoming sorceries and incantations, retaliating with golden power.

name: Improved Ultimate Art Gauge Charge Speed
effect: Improves the charging speed of Ultimate Art gauge by 6%.

name: Character Skill Cooldown Reduction
effect: Shortens Character Skill cooldown time by 10%.

name: Improved Roar & Breath Attacks
effect: Enhances roars and breath attacks by 20%.

name: Improved Throwing Pots
effect: Raises potency of throwing pots by 20%.

name: Improved Perfuming Arts
effect: Raises potency of items employing perfume by 20%.

name: Improved Dodging
effect: Longer invincibility windows during evasive maneuvers. Increase depends on character.

name: Lightning upon Dodging
effect: Evasive maneuvers strike surroundings with lightning.

name: Guard Counters Activate Holy Attacks
effect: Guard counters trigger holy bursts.

name: Guard Counters Activate Summoning Attack
effect: Activation summons a group of Those Lost in Death that attack enemies.

name: Improved Thrusting Counterattack
effect: Enhances counterattacks unique to thrusting weapons by 20%.

name: Improved Flask HP Restoration
effect: Boosts HP Restoration from flasks by 20% / 30%.

name: Flask Also Heals Allies
effect: Heals allies for 50% of flask HP in a radius.

name: Gradual Restoration by Flask
effect: Flask slowly restores HP.

name: Ice Storm Surge Sprint
effect: Produces ice storm at the starting point of surge sprint.

name: Area of Darkness Conceals Caster While Walking
effect: Become difficult to spot and silence footsteps.

name: Flame of Frenzy While Walking
effect: Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth while walking.

name: Violent Deluge of Star Rain While Walking
effect: Summons a dark cloud of stars overhead while walking. The cloud will release a violent deluge of star rain.

name: More Runes From Defeated Enemies
effect: Increased number of runes obtained by 10%.

name: Periodical Giant Glintblades
effect: Creates a glintblade which automatically attack nearby foes at regular intervals.

name: Sudden Enemy Death upon Attacks that Land
effect: Attacked enemies die instantly on rare occasions.

name: HP Restoration upon Successive Attacks
effect: Successive attacks restore 10 HP.

name: FP Restoration upon Successive Attacks
effect: Successive attacks restore 3 FP.

name: Critical Hit HP Restoration
effect: Critical hits restore 10% of Max HP.

name: Critical Hit FP Restoration
effect: Critical hits restore 10% of Max FP.

name: Increased Damage After Critical Hit
effect: Critical hits increases damage inflicted upon enemies by 15%.

name: HP Recovery From Successful Guarding
effect: Restores 10 HP upon guarding.

name: Critical Hits Inflict Blood Loss
effect: Armament inflicts blood loss after performing a critical hit.

name: Create Holy Ground at Low HP
effect: At low HP, create holy ground, slowly restore HP, and improve defense.

name: Poison & Rot Trigger Continuous HP Recovery
effect: Poisoning or Scarlet Rot in vicinity continuously restores 7 HP/s.

name: Blood Loss in Vicinity Increases Attack Power
effect: Nearby blood loss increases attack power by 20%.

name: Traces of Grace-Given Lord
effect: Newly found Sites of Grace raise attack power by ~2% each, max 10 stacks. This effect is acquired by defeating the Fell Omen during the Morgott Invasion Event.

name: Integration of Intelligence
effect: Attacks obtain a great amount of runes from enemies on rare occasions. This effect is acquired by defeating the Sentient Pest that will spawn during the Locusts Plague Event.

name: Unifying Fate
effect: Using flask also restores FP. This effect is acquired by defeating the lesser Augur that will raid you during the Giant Bubbles Event.

name: Demon's Plating
effect: Enhances attack power depending on the runes in possession. This effect is acquired by paying the demon that places a curse on you. This is a random encounter with the lesser version of the Libra that can randomly raid your expedition. The fee costs 15,000 Runes on Day 1 and 35,000 on Day 2.

name: Favor of the Night
effect: Improves the charging speed of Ultimate Art gauge. Acquired by participating in the Night Horde Event.

name: Favor of Noklateo, the Shrouded City
effect: Rise from near-death, unaided, a single time, and become more powerful for a short time. This effect is acquired by interacting with the chest found during the Shifting Earth: Noklateo, the Shrouded City.

name: Favor of the Rotted Woods
effect: Nullifies scarlet rot and increases max HP. Attacks after receiving damage partially recover HP. Acquired by interacting with the Red Flower found during the Shifting Earth: Rotted Woods.

name: Favor of the Mountaintop
effect: Halves frostbite damage and frost buildup. Nearby frostbite boosts attack by 15%. Acquired by interacting with the blue crystals at the top of the region.

name: Unhealed Wound Carved by the Night
effect: Increases damage taken by 20%. This effect is acquired when the targetted player die to the Fell Omen during the Morgott Invasion Event.
